parsed.name: tinySA 频谱分析仪
parsed.description: 用于射频信号观察与基础频谱分析的 tinySA 频谱分析仪，可通过 SCPI/USB 发送命令、执行原始频段扫描、抓取屏幕截图、自检，并调用多种射频测量功能。
parsed.description_en: A tinySA spectrum analyzer for RF signal observation and basic spectrum analysis. It can be controlled over SCPI/USB to send commands, perform raw frequency scans, capture screenshots, run self-tests, and invoke multiple RF measurement functions.
